unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: From the fourth paragraph, we can infer that Mark is in deep love with China.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根记忆: in (向内) + fer (带来) -> 从内部引申出结论就是推断 (infer)。

unit_vocabulary.comparison: which of the following vs all of the following
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Which of the following is TRUE according to the passage?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 固定句式: which (哪一个) + following (接下来的选项) -> 意为“下列哪项”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The passage mentions the following EXCEPT the students' French level.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 形近辨析: ex- (向外) + cept (拿) -> 拿出去不要就是除了 (except)，不要和接受 (accept) 混淆。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Which of the following is TRUE according to the passage?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 短语记忆: accord (一致) + ing + to -> 依据文章内容保持一致，即“根据；按照”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What does the passage mainly talk about?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆: pass (通过) + age -> 文字组成的通道就是短文、文章 (passage)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What does the third paragraph mainly tell us?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根拆分: para (在旁边) + graph (写) -> 写作中独立的一节就是段落 (paragraph)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What does the underlined word "factors" mean in Chinese?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 合成词: under (在下面) + lined (画了线的) -> 词语下方画了线的就是下划线的 (underlined)。

unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What does the underlined word "rough" mean in Paragraph 2?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 巧记辨析: ea组合发长音/iː/，表达“意思是 (mean)”；不要和主要 (main) 搞混。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Lu hopes her readers can learn the cultural meaning behind the clothing.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词缀记忆: mean (意味) + -ing (名词后缀) -> 表达出来的深层意思就是含义 (meaning)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What is the purpose of this passage?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆: pur- (向前) + pose (放置) -> 放在前面作为追求的目标就是目的 (purpose)。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: phrase 主旨大意；中心思想
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What's the main idea of the first paragraph?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 常用短语: main (主要的) + idea (观点/想法) -> 概括全段或全文的核心就是主旨大意。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What does the passage mainly talk about?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词缀记忆: main (主要的) + -ly (副词后缀) -> 表示主体倾向，即“主要地 (mainly)”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The passage mentions the following EXCEPT the pay.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根记忆: ment- (思考/心智) -> 在口头或文字中表达出来就是提及、提到 (mention)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What does the underlined word "It" refer to in Paragraph 3?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 固定搭配: refer to 常考代词指代题，问代词在文中究竟指的是 (refer to) 哪件事物。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Which of the following is TRUE about Scooter?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 基础词汇: true表示“符合事实的、正确的”，名词形式为 truth (真相)。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: phrase 不正确的；不符合事实的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Which of the following is NOT true according to the text?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 否定判断: not + true 常见于细节反选推断题，需要选出与原文事实不符的选项。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What's the advantage of the WindWing?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 反义记忆: advance (前进) -> 走在别人前面就拥有优势 (advantage)，反义词加 dis-。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Which of the following is the correct order of events?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆: 排队点餐需要按顺序 (order)，阅读排序题常考 in the right order。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What is the structure of the text?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根记忆: struct (建造) + ure (名词后缀) -> 建筑或文章的脉络骨架就是结构 (structure)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What's the best title for the text?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 巧记辨析: ti-tle (标题)，阅读主旨大意题常问：“What's the best title for the passage?”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What do the two apartments have in common?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 常用短语: have sth. in common 表示“在某方面有共同点”，常见于比较阅读题。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Which of the following can be put back in the blank?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 短语拆分: put (放置) + back (回到原处) -> 七选五或填空题常问哪个句子能被放回原位。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Choose the best option to fill in the blank.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆: blank 中间的 an 像一张白纸空空如也，fill in the blank 即“填空”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Read the instruction carefully before answering questions.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根拆分: in- (向内) + struct (构建) + -ion -> 把步骤构建在脑海里的文字就是说明、指示。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Choose the best option from A, B, C and D.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根记忆: opt (选择) + -ion -> 题目下方供你挑选的选择支就是选项 (option)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Which statement is supported by the facts in the passage?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根拆分: state (陈述/说明) + -ment (名词后缀) -> 表达出来的言论就是陈述、说法。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What conclusion can we draw from the experiment?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 短语搭配: draw a conclusion (得出结论)；con- (共同) + clud (关闭) -> 最终定案就是结论。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: From the story we can conclude that kindness always pays off.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根对比: in-clude (包括进内)，con-clude (汇总并得出最终结论)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The passage is most probably an advertisement.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 形近辨析: probable (可能的) + -ly -> 大概率地 (probably)；注意和适当妥当 (properly) 区分。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Choose the best answer for each question.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 最高级记忆: good/well -> better -> best (最好的)，题干中常常要求挑选 the best option。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The author uses vivid words to describe the beautiful sunset.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根记忆: de- (向下) + scribe (写) -> 把事物用文字详细写下来就是描述 (describe)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What is the writer's attitude towards the new invention?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 形近辨析: altitude 是海拔高度 (al- 高)，attitude 是做人做事的态度 (at-)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What is the main reason why the tower leans?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 形近辨析: 一年有四季 (season)，凡事皆有前因后果与理由 (reason)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The writer writes the passage to tell a touching story.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词缀记忆: write (写) + -er (人) -> 撰写文章的人就是作者、作家 (writer)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What does the author want to express in this paragraph?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆: author 指著书立说的大师级作者，比 writer 更加具有学术或专业色彩。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What is the tone of the writer in the last paragraph?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆: 讲话的音调与口吻就是语调、语气 (tone)；去掉前面的 s 就是 stone (石头)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The study results suggest that sleep is vital for health.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根拆分: sub- (在下方) + gest (搬运) -> 暗中把想法传递出来，即“表明、暗示、建议”。

unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What do Mark's words in the third paragraph show?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 高频动词: show 表示“展示、显现、表明”，阅读题干常问：“What does the text show?”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What can we learn from the experience of the young athlete?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 常用搭配: learn (学习) + from (从……) -> “What can we learn from...?” 常用于推断启示题。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Select the appropriate option from the wordbank to complete the passage.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 合成词: word (单词/词汇) + bank (库/银行) -> 储存备选词汇的词库就是 wordbank。
